description: This Java class defines a REST controller named `HelloController` within a Spring Boot application. It provides endpoints for greeting, documentation redirect, health check, and application info, utilizing Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation purposes.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints such as greeting, documentation redirection, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the root URL, returning a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /docs, constructing a redirect to the Swagger UI page based on the incoming request.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /health, returning a simple 'OK' status to indicate application health.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests to /api/info, returning application information.
